query:
WITH price_at_start AS (
                    SELECT open_price
                    FROM chart
                    WHERE token_id = $1
                    AND interval_type = $2
                    AND time_stamp <= $3
                    ORDER BY time_stamp DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                ),
                price_at_current AS (
                    SELECT close_price
                    FROM chart
                    WHERE token_id = $1
                    AND interval_type = $2
                    AND time_stamp <= $4
                    ORDER BY time_stamp DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                )
                SELECT
                    (SELECT open_price FROM price_at_start) as start_price,
                    (SELECT close_price FROM price_at_current) as current_price
